ECEN-662.name: Estimation & Detection Theory
ECEN-662.description:
This course covers the fundamentals of statistical
                        inference, including both statistical principles and
                        computational techniques such as variational
                        inference and sampling methods. This course is the
                        natural continuation of the graduate-level probability/random-process class and is designed to prepare students to take advanced machine learning classes.

ECEN-689.name: Multimodal Computer Vision - Principles and Applications
ECEN-689.description:
Motivations, algorithms, and models for multimodal computer vision; integration of images, text, and LiDAR;
                        image formation and camera models; 3D vision and multi-view geometry; representation learning and self-
                        supervised methods; generative AI and diffusion processes; applications in robotics, autonomous driving, and
                        AR/VR; hands-on labs to build, fine-tune, and deploy multimodal vision models; tasks include text-to-image
                        generation, 3D generation and reconstruction, and robotic perception.

ECEN-743.name: Reinforcement Learning
ECEN-743.description: Introduction to the theory and practice of reinforcement learning; Topics include Markov decision processes; dynamic programming; Q-Learning; policy gradient algorithms; deep reinforcement learning; imitation learning; meta learning; multi-agent learning.
